description: Governs post-game analytics in Dota AI Coach — analyzing laning, farm, item timings, deaths, teamfights, objectives, buyback, power spikes, turning points, and recommendation adherence after a match ends, using full match/replay data now legitimately available. Use whenever building, modifying, or reviewing post-game analysis, a match report, or any feature comparing a player's performance to a reference group. This is where POSTGAME_ONLY data (per dota-fairplay) is meant to be used — but it comes with its own discipline: distinguishing correlation from causality, respecting sample size, and surfacing a few real insights instead of a wall of statistics. A report that claims an item won the game because it was bought before winning is a bug here, not a stylistic choice.
